name: whaler_careened
notes: The Gannet Harbor whaler hauled out for re-coppering: the same 32 m hull as `whaler`, heeled 36 degrees onto her starboard side on a timber cradle on a two-rail marine railway, topmasts and yards sent down and lower masts leaning out over +X, her bottom turned up to -X with new copper on the forward half and old green copper aft, shores under the high side and a plank staging along the bottom on trestles. Bow to local -Z; the rails run the length of the footprint. Levels the ground; carves nothing.
